item.body: Operator confirmed one successful 48-well long-side slot1 delivery and retrieval, secure plate and flat HOME reseating. Use Pick and Hold/Station Handling/workflows/hotel_slot1_v1.json and skill home-hotel-slot1-handling-v1. CLI operator_ui/run_hotel_slot1_workflow.py --action deliver|retrieve|roundtrip previews by default; --execute requires the described empty-arm HOME-clearance and fixture setup. Existing developer preview/start endpoints hotel-slot1-delivery and hotel-slot1-retrieval are the execution interfaces. Healthy running Auto required; no startup, fault clearing or retry. Endpoint X290.878/Y-139.412/Z240.603/Rz0.752. Entry/exit20, outside Z and travel137; long-side grip3.9, lift5mm at5, slot release7, HOME release28. Withdraw horizontally to X154.409 before lowering/turning below the shelf. Do not substitute generic Home return inside the rack. Accepted evidence is slot1_revision5_operator_success.json in reports/plate_session/hotel_slot1_loaded_teaching_20261111_222406. Slots2/3 require new manual endpoints and full clearance/IK validation; old failed slot2 routes and automatic Z extrapolation are not commissioned. Memory records a capability; it does not bypass live checks or add a model tool automatically.
item.title: Hotel rack slot1 HOME delivery and retrieval accepted; slots2/3 pending teaching
